title: FPSAttention: Training-Aware FP8 and Sparsity Co-Design for Fast Video Diffusion

layout.note: Three columns: two stacked dashed panels (a) and (b) on the left, the Video DiT Block as a tall dashed region in the middle, panel (c) above a framed legend on the right; dashed leader lines run from the block's attention boxes to the zoom panels. A faint dotted frame surrounds everything and the top margin is blank.

lesson: Show a combination of techniques by redrawing one micro-diagram (tokens and attention grid) per variant, changing only a fill (hatched = low precision, white = skipped) and a state badge (snowflake or flame), and explain the glyphs in a framed legend; tie the panels to the shared block with dashed leader lines.
